# WO-2026-08-19-01 — The lane runs, the trolley is read back truthfully, and the runtime tells the truth about itself
# guidance: WO-YYYY-MM-DD-nn — slice title

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — ⛔ THE RUNTIME MUST NOT NARRATE A STATE IT IS NOT IN.** At 22:42:45Z shop 37 transitioned
`NEEDS_DECISION → PROCESSING` announcing *"every question is answered — re-planning with the answers in
place"* while **all seven questions were open and none was answered.** The transition was correct; the
sentence was false. **Find every event description that asserts a fact it has not checked, and make it
state what is true** — a supersession re-plan is not an answered board. A state machine that narrates a
false predicate is how nobody notices the real one.

**AC2 — THE LANE LAUNCHES AND EXECUTES.** The config is placed and the validator that refused now
passes. Take the lane from a queued request to a real browser session and a built trolley. **Where a
real Chrome is genuinely required, that is now available** — this AC is no longer offline-only.
⛔ **The absolute boundaries are unchanged and enforced in code: never book a slot, never check out,
never pay, never enter the ASDA password, never auto-substitute.**

**AC3 — THE TROLLEY IS READ BACK TRUTHFULLY.** *"A total and an item count are insufficient"* —
Warwick, and it is already in the tests. Reconciliation must derive from what is **in the trolley**,
line by line, and must **refuse to announce "basket ready"** when it cannot account for a line. The
three-counters defect (`reconcile.cjs:58-71`) has a regression test; make sure the production path is
the one it covers.

**AC4 — AUTONOMOUS WAKE, CRASH AND RESTART, PROVEN BY BEING MADE TO FAIL.** Kill the runtime
mid-shop; it must resume from durable state with no human. TEN gaps 4 and 7. **A test that starts a
thing and observes it running proves nothing** — kill it and prove the revival.

**AC5 — NO SILENT FAILURE ANYWHERE ON THE LANE.** Extend the first-occurrence notification already
built to every terminal condition on this route. **Prove each is EMITTED**, with the outbox row.

**AC6 — NOTHING ALREADY WORKING MOVES.** The decision path, the contract digest, the model-provenance
board, the supersession, the attempt ceiling, 37/37 interpret.
# guidance: each independently checkable. If automatic, no AC may be satisfiable by a manual invocation of the delivered script alone.
